changes: The June base map is resampled and combined with cloud cover in linear light. There is no baked solar disc or specular highlight.
Earth Clouds by Solar System Scope (CC BY 4.0) is resampled into colour and roughness masks.
Above-sea-level ETOPO1 slopes become tangent-space normals. The borders continue across the poles.
